camel_example: aliyun ons TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 TopicA --Tag.1.Key FinanceDept --Tag.1.Value FinanceJoshua --ResourceType TOPIC
kebab_example: aliyun ons tag-resources --resource-type TOPIC --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --resource-id TopicA --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ instance that contains the resource to which you want to attach tags.

This parameter is required when you attach tags to a topic or a group
parameters.help_zh:
所需绑定标签的资源所在的实例的ID。
如需为Topic或Group ID绑定标签，则必须填写该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource to which you want to attach tags. Valid values:

INSTANCE
TOPIC
GROUP
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。枚举类型。取值：

INSTANCE
TOPIC
GROUP
parameters.name: resource_type

fields.help_en:
The tag key. If you configure this parameter, you must also configure the Value parameter.****
The value of this parameter cannot be an empty string.
A tag key must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. A tag key cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。Key和Value值必须同时输入。

该值不允许为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag that you want to attach to the resource. If you configure this parameter, you must also configure the Key parameter.****
The value of this parameter can be an empty string.
A tag value must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. A tag value cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。Key和Value值必须同时输入。

该值可以为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags that you want to attach to the resource
parameters.name: tag

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This parameter is a common parameter. Each request has a unique ID. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
